item.title: Police say more than 150 bodies recovered after flash flood on Nepal-Tibet border with hundreds still missing – latest
item.summary: Latest Nepal police update says 157 bodies found after powerful floods in Himalayan border area sweep away houses, roads and bridges Flash floods on Nepal-Tibet border leave scores dead and hundreds missing Tell us: have you been affected by the flash floods? The British embassy in Kathmandu said it is “deeply saddened” by flash floods in parts of Nepal and urged people in affected areas to follow local advice. A joint statement with the embassies of Australia, the EU, Finland, France, Norway and Switzerland said: We are deeply saddened by the devastating flooding in Rasuwa and Nuwakot districts and surrounding areas. Our thoughts are with all those affected by this disaster. We express our solidarity with the people of Nepal during this difficult time. Continue reading...
